remarks: Welcome to this bright and inviting 2-bedroom ground-floor corner unit overlooking a beautiful courtyard in the heart of Norwalk. This newly painted home features a spacious living room, an eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances, oak cabinetry, and ample space for dining. Off the back hallway, you'll find two quiet bedrooms-each with generous closets-and an updated bathroom. All together it is a charming place to call home for life and entertaining.  An assigned parking space, and a private storage unit. The well-maintained complex offers beautiful landscaped grounds, a new heating system, newer roofs, and convenient community laundry areas. Ideally located just minutes from Norwalk Hospital, School I-95, the Route 7 connector, public transportation, shops, and restaurants, this sun-filled home is perfect for comfortable living. Heat and hot water are included-making this an exceptional find in a prime location!
